description: Who is betting big on this Polymarket market, and are they any good? Pass a market slug, link or condition id: the biggest holders on each side (shares, value at the current price, name), the top 5 per side with their all-time P&L and leaderboard rank, and how many proven (profitable) traders sit on each side. Live from Polymarket's public data. Not advice. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.

market.description: A market slug (the last part of its polymarket.com URL), the URL itself, or a 0x condition id
